overall_summary: Core self-respect content shows steady low-tier baseline views (20-41 views), but recent family and relationship relationship-dynamics experiments (like wife/father/family emotional shorts) drastically outperformed romantic heartbreak hooks, peaking at 1,401 views. We should lean into the broader emotional family/relationship dynamic as an experimentation branch while keeping core self-respect storytelling intact.

winning_patterns.evidence: Wife/husband and parent emotional videos (e.g., or5gtaBpRVY, rl_ycNbXZ_g) achieved 1,401 and 287 views, outperforming niche romantic heartbreak content.
winning_patterns.action: Blend relationship communication and underlying mutual respect into the narrative to widen appeal beyond single heartbreak.

winning_patterns.evidence: Phrases referencing concrete digital or physical actions ('चैट डिलीट', 'स्टेटस लिस्ट', 'कीबोर्ड से नाम') drive consistent mid-tier viewership in self-respect topics.
winning_patterns.action: Continue utilizing very specific, tactile modern micro-actions as opening hooks.

weak_patterns.evidence: Clichéd midnight/tea/online status tropes (e.g., 'रात के दो बजे', 'चाय ठंडी हो गई') yielded lower views (6-13 views).
weak_patterns.action: Acknowledge but deprecate abstract poetic openings in favor of hyper-specific everyday relationship moments.

weak_patterns.evidence: Videos without clear categorical topics had erratic initial delivery until catching traction on broad themes.
weak_patterns.action: Maintain clear tagging and structured thematic hooks even when expanding into family/general relationship emotions.
